beats.label: S1 · Erasmus arrives
beats.text: English pilot John Blackthorne washes up in Ajiro. Toranaga, being impeached by the other four regents, seizes the Protestant heretic as a wedge against his Catholic rivals.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Toranaga-vs-council war and Blackthorne's role as its unlikely lever — every later move builds on this.

beats.label: S1 · Escape from Osaka
beats.text: Cornered in Osaka, Toranaga escapes hidden in his wife's litter with Blackthorne's help, then resigns his regency to dissolve the council before it can vote his death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Buys Toranaga the time and moral standing to fight from Edo; his resignation reshapes the council for the rest of the season.

beats.label: S1 · Hatamoto in Ajiro
beats.text: Toranaga names Blackthorne hatamoto to train a musket regiment in Ajiro. Mariko interprets for him, and the two begin a secret affair despite her marriage to Buntaro.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Anchors Blackthorne inside Toranaga's household and forges the Mariko relationship whose ending drives the finale.

beats.label: S1 · Ochiba locks Osaka
beats.text: Ochiba, the heir's mother, returns to Osaka and backs Ishido. They seize the regents' families as hostages, and Toranaga's impeachment becomes unavoidable.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Ochiba as the real power beside Ishido — the alliance whose collapse is the season's endgame.

beats.label: S1 · Saeki turns; Toranaga yields
beats.text: Toranaga's half-brother Saeki takes the vacant regency and demands his surrender; Nagakado dies in a botched ambush. Toranaga yields, and Hiromatsu commits seppuku to sell it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment the war looks lost — and the setup Toranaga needs Ishido to believe before he can strike.

beats.label: S1 · Mariko's martyrdom
beats.text: Sent to Osaka to demand the hostages' release, Mariko refuses to yield to Ishido and dies in a shinobi bombing — shaming him and turning Ochiba against him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The event that actually breaks Ishido's coalition; the pivot on which Toranaga's whole plan swings.

beats.label: S1 · The plan revealed
beats.text: Toranaga tells Yabushige the surrender was theater — Mariko's death broke Ochiba's alliance. He burns the Erasmus to keep Blackthorne, and moves to become shōgun.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes the whole season as Toranaga's long game and sets the board — war coming, Blackthorne stranded — for what follows.

cliffhanger.text: Toranaga's staged defeat has worked. Mariko's martyrdom has broken Ochiba's alliance with Ishido, the council has voted for open war, and Toranaga is finally free to move on Osaka and claim the shōgunate — with Blackthorne stranded in Japan, his ship secretly burned on Toranaga's orders.
questions: Can Toranaga finish Ishido now that Ochiba has pulled her support?
Will Ochiba's break from Ishido soften her long-standing hatred of Toranaga, or only redirect it?
What is left for Blackthorne in Japan without Mariko and without a ship home?

characters.name: Yoshii Toranaga
characters.line: The last of the five regents standing; his fake surrender and Mariko's death have cleared his path to strike Ishido and claim the shōgunate.

characters.name: John Blackthorne
characters.line: English pilot and Toranaga's hatamoto, stranded after Toranaga secretly ordered the Erasmus destroyed; grieving Mariko and salvaging the wreck to build a fleet.

characters.name: Ishido Kazunari
characters.line: Leader of the four opposing regents, publicly shamed by Mariko's death and abandoned by Ochiba; the council has just voted open war on Toranaga.

characters.name: Ochiba no Kata
characters.line: Mother of the child heir Yaechiyo and long convinced Toranaga killed her father; her withdrawal from Ishido after Mariko's death is what cleared Toranaga's path.

characters.name: Toda Mariko
characters.line: Christian noblewoman, Toranaga's interpreter and Blackthorne's lover; sent to Osaka to free the hostages, she died in a shinobi bombing rather than yield.

characters.name: Toda Buntaro
characters.line: Toranaga's samurai and Mariko's widower; now in Ajiro helping Blackthorne salvage the Erasmus.

characters.name: Kashigi Yabushige
characters.line: The scheming lord of Izu who played both sides all season; executed himself by Toranaga's order after his betrayal of Osaka was exposed.
